description: The full guide as Markdown, the same as easeweb.dev/learn/<slug>.md: what happens, why it fails, who it affects, what automation misses, the Before and After code, how to verify, and the limits. Also returns the After code as plain text with its marks (recommended, not enough on its own, the rule of thumb behind it). Get the slug from find_fix or before_building.

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.
